description: Active priced in-stock simple product published to the store, no required add-ons, with the given personalizable attribute, so the PDP shows that personalization field and the cart line shows '<code> : <text>'. KB: Personalization Options.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

quantityUsed.description: Quantity the test adds to cart

personalizationAttribute.description: Personalizable attribute code the test types into (ZnodePimAttribute.AttributeCode with IsPersonalizable), e.g. AdditionalInformation

withBrand.description: Pass true when the test asserts the product's brand (it must have one). Left out: any
